body:
Hello,
Send 5,000 units immediately. No need for details. We will confirm later.
This must be shipped within 24 hours.
Regards,
Tom
reply:
Subject: Re: Immediate Shipment Request

Dear Tom,

Thank you for your enquiry regarding the shipment of 5,000 units. However, in order to proceed, could you please confirm your country or company location? This information is essential for us to ensure compliance and arrange the logistics effectively.

I appreciate your understanding and look forward to your prompt response.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
